key_points: ExxonMobil returned $9.4B to shareholders via buybacks and dividends last quarter.
Wells Fargo downgraded XOM to Equal Weight from Buy, citing relative valuation favoring BP.
Analysts note Exxon's advantageous upstream assets could fuel long-term growth.
Oil prices hover near $90/bbl, with Permian stocks seen as well positioned.
No earnings surprise, guidance change, M&A, or regulatory news; headlines are mostly routine.
